blurb: Guests enjoy private boat tours on Lake George, cruising the lake to see scenery and landmarks, swimming, cliff jumping, fishing, and visiting day islands. Tours include water recreation and opportunities for fishing with provided rods and tackle. The captain handles all boat operations so guests can relax and enjoy the experience.
extraNote: $100 deposit required for all boat tour bookings · Deposit refundable with 24 hour notice for inclement weather · Deposit refundable with 7 days notice for other cancellations · Maximum 8 passengers per booking · Tours available 7 days a week from June 15th through October 15th · Right to cancel at any time with full refund · No water-skiing, knee-boarding, wake-boarding, or surfing allowed · Rates subject to increase due to gas prices · Chelka Lodge, meet 15 minutes prior to reservation time · June 15th through October 15th
